Loads arriving early must be scheduled through central dispatch at least 48 hours in advance; detention will not be honored for unscheduled arrivals.
Drivers are required to wear face coverings and follow social distancing guidelines. They may also be subject to temperature checks upon arrival.

RECEIVING PROTOCOL:
1. Check in at the guard shack with BOL and photo ID — no exceptions.
2. Tarps remain ON until a dock door is assigned by the receiving supervisor.
3. Hazmat loads stage in the marked lane only; placards verified before unload.
4. Overages, shortages and damages must be noted on the POD before the driver leaves the yard.
DELIVERY INSTRUCTIONS: Deliver to dock 15C only. Facility requires Monday - Friday 7:30-3:30-hour advance appointment scheduling. Contact dispatch at (301) 406-8664 to confirm slot availability.
